fields.name: PreserveSurfaceCurvature
fields.xmlDoc: If the discrete curvature of the mesh surface be taken into account during simplification. Taking surface curvature into account can result in good quality mesh simplification, but it can slow the simplification process significantly. Default value: false

fields.name: EnableSmartLink
fields.xmlDoc: If a feature for smarter vertex linking should be enabled, reducing artifacts in the decimated result at the cost of a slightly more expensive initialization by treating vertices at the same position as the same vertex while separating the attributes. Default value: true

fields.name: VertexLinkDistance
fields.xmlDoc: The maximum distance between two vertices in order to link them. Note that this value is only used if EnableSmartLink is true. Default value: double.Epsilon

fields.name: MaxIterationCount
fields.xmlDoc: The maximum iteration count. Higher number is more expensive but can bring you closer to your target quality. Sometimes a lower maximum count might be desired in order to lower the performance cost. Default value: 100

fields.name: Agressiveness
fields.xmlDoc: The agressiveness of the mesh simplification. Higher number equals higher quality, but more expensive to run. Default value: 7.0

fields.name: ManualUVComponentCount
fields.xmlDoc: If a manual UV component count should be used (set by UVComponentCount), instead of the automatic detection. Default value: false

fields.name: UVComponentCount
fields.xmlDoc: The UV component count. The same UV component count will be used on all UV channels. Default value: 2

properties.name: SimplificationOptions
properties.xmlDoc: Gets or sets all of the simplification options as a single block. Default value: SimplificationOptions.Default

properties.name: PreserveBorderEdges
properties.xmlDoc: Gets or sets if the border edges should be preserved. Default value: false

properties.name: PreserveUVFoldoverEdges
properties.xmlDoc: Gets or sets if the UV foldover edges should be preserved. Default value: false

properties.name: PreserveSurfaceCurvature
properties.xmlDoc: Gets or sets if the discrete curvature of the mesh surface be taken into account during simplification. Default value: false

properties.name: EnableSmartLink

Default value: true

properties.name: MaxIterationCount

properties.name: Agressiveness
properties.xmlDoc: Gets or sets the agressiveness of the mesh simplification. Higher number equals higher quality, but more expensive to run. Default value: 7.0

properties.name: Verbose
properties.xmlDoc: Gets or sets if verbose information should be printed to the console. Default value: false

properties.name: VertexLinkDistance
properties.xmlDoc: Gets or sets the maximum distance between two vertices in order to link them. Note that this value is only used if EnableSmartLink is true.

properties.name: VertexLinkDistanceSqr
